description: Ernemann于1925年推出的盒式相机。配备1:12.5 meniscus lens。快门速度Time, Bulb and Instant mode (Z, S and M)。使用unperforated paper backed 35mm roll film (Sida 26° film was an appropriate brand) / 22×33mm frame。
